summary: Read-mostly workspace consistency audit joining worktrees, plan artifacts, active-plan registry records, claim locks, uncommitted work, and follow-up opportunities; cleanup is opt-in per flag with per-item confirmation.

flags.summary: Offer dead worktrees for git worktree remove after per-item confirmation.
Move stale/precontext plans to .abandoned with sentinel after confirmation.
Remove eligible orphan/stale/corrupt claim locks only after three safety checks.
Deregister stale registry records individually by run id.
Create deduped follow-up entries for advisory findings.
Persist report to RECONCILE.md or provided save path.

entry_points.summary: Parse cleanup flags and optional save path.
Collect facts and render read-only report.
Collect status, remote reachability, unpushed state, ancestry, merge evidence.
Collect tasks, merge evidence, latest activity, abandoned exclusion.
Build CrossRefInput and compute report booleans.
Precedence detached > dirty > unknown-remote > merged-uncertain > dead > active; only dead prune eligible.
Classify plan by precontext/task completion/merge evidence/staleness.
Read-only claim status: held/free/stale/corrupt; used before lock cleanup.

safety_model.lock_cleanup: reap-stale eligible + no registry record + dead daemon pid
safety_model.plan_archive: move to .abandoned; never delete; tasks-complete-unmerged is advisory only

save_convention: --save writes RECONCILE.md at repo root; positional save path implies --save and overrides target.

staleness_threshold.basis: max latest events.jsonl timestamp and artifact mtime

invariants: Every mutation requires explicit flag and per-item confirmation.
tasks-complete-unmerged is advisory and never auto-archived.
Lock removal requires reap-stale eligibility, no live registry record, and non-live daemon PID.
Registry global reap is never called.
gotchas: Remote reachability timeout/failure yields unknown-remote and surface-only.
has_unpushed None routes to unknown-remote regardless of remote_reachable value.
merged_worktree_on_disk excludes dead worktrees already on prune path.
Staleness uses latest activity, not directory mtime.
Follow-ups section is always rendered; --open-followups controls creation only.
